[2] Zoe is extremely fragile, meaning any misstep, mis cool down, or bad positioning can instantly get her killed
[2] A common mistake is throwing a bubble randomly, hoping it hits, and when it misses, you lose all pressure.
[2] Side laning on Zoe is more situational. She doesn't have the best escapes, so you need to be careful when pushing side waves.
[2] It's easy to treat it like safety mobility, but your return point is predictable and can be punished.
[2] Most players will stand behind the wave for safety, so using the splash damage lets you slowly chip them down.
[2] When the wave is pushed, it becomes much easier to land your E and long-range Qs without minions blocking you.
[2] Enemies will naturally hide behind minions to dodge your E
[2] When you're pushing consistently, the enemy is forced to use abilities on the wave. That's your window to poke, trade, and look for a bubble.
[2] Zoe has strong roaming potential. Surprise enemies with long-range Es through walls.
[2] Use bubble through walls to extend its range. Terrain stretches the cast, making it harder to react to and giving Zoe strong pick potential around walls.
